events.speaker: CLEMENTINE
events.text: Hands here, pressure steady, don't flinch when it looks bad. It's going to look bad. Do that and you're more use to me than most.

events.speaker: CLEMENTINE
events.text: Patient's stable and you didn't panic once. I've served with soldiers who managed less.

events.speaker: CLEMENTINE
events.text: An outfit that doesn't get in the way during a crisis is worth riding with. I'm in.

events.speaker: CLEMENTINE
events.text: I don't do comfort talk easy. But you kept your head when it counted, and that's the part I actually notice.
